title: En Aasai Machan
desc: Arusamy, a village chief, remains unmarried in order to take care of Subramani, his younger brother. However, he has to pay a heavy price when Subramani falls in love with Meenakshi.

title: Muppozhudhum Un Karpanaigal
desc: A man falls in love with a girl with a mysterious past. However, her true identity is revealed when the man has an accident.

title: Neruppuda
desc: Guru, an aspiring firefighter, leads a group of friends who dream of saving lives, but their journey takes a dangerous turn when they accidentally provoke a gang.
During a curfew imposed in two quarreling villages, a small-time thief, a driver and an artist team up to steal gold from an unjust politician.

title: Naan Than Bala
desc: Bala, a principled priest, forms an improbable friendship with Poochi, a contract killer. Despite their starkly contrasting lives, their bond deepens profoundly.
